name: TRON 1
summary: A torso-less biped research platform sold by LimX Dynamics with three swappable lower-limb end effectors — point feet, ankle-less 'sole' feet and wheels — so one machine covers several locomotion research problems. It ships with an open SDK and Isaac / MuJoCo / Gazebo integration and starts around US$15,000.
notable: Swappable feet / point / wheel end effectors on one platform
Low-cost open SDK locomotion research rig
